caption:
I tripped on the stairs

i tripped on the stairs. everyone saw. (nobody was there)

For whoever is still thinking about that one time.

The theory: the spotlight effect, we think others notice our slips far more than they do (Gilovich, Medvec and Savitsky, 2000, Journal of Personality and Social Psychology). An example, not a diagnosis.

alt: A short film with no voice. A coral room with a cream staircase on the right: four steps, each with a flat top and a front face, and a handrail on posts. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes walks to the steps and trips on the first one, eyes wide. It looks left, right, up and at the camera, shrinks a little and squints. The room is empty. Then it relaxes, pulses with happy eyes and goes on up. The text stays: i tripped on the stairs, everyone saw, (nobody was there).
